mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth above 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated monetary policy responses.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE below 6%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% MoM, coupled with a rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 10% YoY, signals a supply-side driven economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with joint trigger conditions met.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 5% YoY signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during the holiday season (Nov-Jan).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of holiday seasons with RSAFS YoY growth above 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50bps in a single month signals an aggressive monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but with increased volatility.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances with FEDFUNDS decrease > 50bps in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5%) and high payroll employment (PAYEMS > 140,000) signals a labor market at full capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated inflation pressures.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with joint trigger conditions met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high GDP growth rate (GDPC1 > 4% YoY) without corresponding increases in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2% YoY) signals a productivity-driven economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth above 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth below 2%.
